name: Consent-O-Matic
tagline: Browser extension that automatically fills out cookie popups based on user preferences
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Relies on volunteer maintenance; dependent on browser API stability and cookie consent regulation changes

academic_citations.title: Consent-O-Matic: Automatically Answering Consent Pop-ups Using Adversarial Interoperability
Echocardiographic determination of left ventricular mass in man. Anatomic validation of the method.

documented_limitations: Limited to cookie consent popups; effectiveness depends on website compliance with consent standards; may not work with all consent management platforms
failure_modes: Extension may fail when websites use non-standard consent implementations; updates required as consent platforms evolve
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines on GitHub; community-driven feature requests
contributor_governance: GitHub-based open source model with community contributions
